keep user requirements, public-source facts, autonomous design, and pending unknowns separate

public_source_fact: the inherited source-facing radial-inverse structure uses a lower limit at r=0; this contract does not add any new public numerical source parameter
autonomous_design: PR #875 reconstructs the unweighted first-cell source from the first three strictly positive radii with a degree-2 Lagrange polynomial
PR #875 integrates r^e times that extrapolant analytically over [0,r_min] for e in {1,2}
PR #875 records a separate degree-1 affine first-cell estimate only as a local sensitivity diagnostic
the hidden-cell mechanics witness in this contract uses r_min=0.2 and H(r)=(r_min-r)^4 on 0<=r<r_min, zero at and above r_min
the CR001 finite-difference, quadrature, forcing, nontriviality, and validation thresholds are repository choices
pending_unknown: an independently justified regularity or shape bound for the real typed source on the unsampled interval [0,r_min] sufficient to turn extrapolation disagreement into an error bound
real-source first-cell convergence under radial refinement
formal first-cell accuracy for the real typed source
formal axis-based inverse equivalence for the realized finite-grid operator

observability_boundary.statement: Agreement of the degree-1 and degree-2 extrapolated first-cell integrals is not, by itself, an a-posteriori error certificate for the formal 0-to-r_min integral. Both estimators use only positive-radius node values, so without an independently justified source regularity/shape bound they cannot exclude a sub-first-cell contribution that vanishes at every observed positive node.
observability_boundary.witness_definition: H(r)=(r_min-r)^4 for 0<=r<r_min and H(r)=0 for r>=r_min
observability_boundary.sampled_positive_node_values: all zero for every node r>=r_min
observability_boundary.consequence: zero estimator disagreement does not imply zero formal first-cell error in the sample-only observation model
